explanation: Try each grid cell as a starting position. Recursively match the pattern through four-neighbor steps, caching failed cell/offset states separately for each starting cell; revisiting a cell at a later offset is allowed.
timeComplexity: O((rc)²·m) worst case, for an r×c grid and pattern length m
